title: 第066章 十丈法相修炼开始第065章 第二次远征天圣
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：全民修仙之系统上交囯家正文第066章：十丈法相修炼开始（..la）时间加速修炼室门合拢的速度比他想象中慢。
张德华站在门槛内侧，看着门板从两侧向中间平移。门缝收窄的过程中，外面的光线正在被逐寸压缩，从三指宽缩到两指，从两指缩到一指，最后只剩下一条发丝般的细线。那道细线在地板上持续亮了大约一息，然后熄灭了。
修炼室内部的光是冷白色的，从天顶四角的灵光板上均匀地洒下来。他站在光里，低头看了一眼自己的右手。
掌心那道结晶碎块的痕迹还在——透明的、像被水洗过的玻璃碎片一样的痕迹，嵌在掌纹之间，不疼，但能感觉到那里有一小块比周围皮肤更硬的区域。他把手掌翻了个面，对着光看了看。透明的碎片在冷白光下反射出一丝极淡的金色，像一粒被埋在沙里的金子碎屑。他没有多看，把手放下来，走到蒲团前坐下。
蒲团的边缘已经压出了一道浅痕。他上一次离开的时候，坐的位置被他的重量压出了一个极浅的凹陷，十五天之后那道凹陷还留着，没有回弹。他把手搭在膝盖上，合拢，闭上眼。
第一年。
前四个月他没有动。炼化结晶残片的过程比预期中更长，那枚透明的碎片正在被他的灵能一层一层地剥开，像剥洋葱一样，每一层都带着一丝极淡的金色光芒从掌心的经脉中渗入他的丹田。第五个月的时候，他的法相虚影开始在背后凝聚。
八十丈。和禁地门口那次一样的高度。但这次的光比那次更稳定，没有闪烁，没有颤动，像一尊已经被浇铸完成、正在缓慢冷却的铜像。他试着收拢它。收拢的过程中他感到了一股阻力——像一个人试图把一床浸了水的棉被塞进一只比它小得多的箱子里。
法相的边缘在收拢到六十丈的时候就停住了，没有再往里缩。他试了三次，三次都在六十丈的位置上停住，像一面撞上了什么看不见的墙。
第七个月，他开始换一种方法。不强行收拢，先观察那面"墙"。
他发现那面墙不是法相本身的边界，是结晶残片中的某一层结构正在对抗他灵能的压缩力。那层结构很薄，像一张被夹在两层纸之间的书签。他花了整整一个月才把它从结晶残片中剥离出来。剥离之后，法相从六十丈收拢到了五十丈。第五十丈到四十丈之间隔了三个半月。
四十丈到三十丈之间隔了四个月零七天。三十丈到二十丈之间，是这一年的最后一个月——他用了整整三十天，把法相从三十丈压到了二十丈。二十丈。
第二年。
二十丈是另一面墙。比上一次那面更厚，也更硬。他试着用同样的方法剥离，但这一层结构已经和法相本身融在一起了，分不开。他只能用持续的灵能压力去"磨"。
每天两个时辰，把灵能灌入法相内部，像一个正在用手工凿子刻石头的匠人。进度很慢。第一个月，二十丈到十九丈。第二个月到第十八丈。
第三个月到第十七丈。进度在第十个月的时候加速了一截——他找到了一个角度，把灵能从法相的左肩处灌入，那股阻力忽然变小了。
最后两个月，他从十二丈压到了十一丈。但第十一丈到第十丈之间，他试了很多次，每一次都被弹回到十一丈。
第三年。
第三年的第一个月，他暂停了压缩。
他坐在蒲团上，把灵能撤回来，完整地休息了三天。

三天里他什么也没做，只是坐着，呼吸，感知修炼室里那层恒定的冷白光从头顶照下来。第三天傍晚，他重新开始的时候，他发现那层阻力自己松了一些。不是完全消失，是松了一丝，像一扇被卡了很久的门因为木头干燥收缩而自己松动了半寸。他把灵能送进去的时候，法相从十一丈收拢到了十丈半。
那一截只有半丈，但他感觉到那面墙的质地正在改变，正在从"拒绝"变成"容纳"。第三年的最后六个月，他专注于稳定十丈法相的形态。
每一次法相在十丈处停住的时候，他能感觉到它的密度正在增加。
光更密了，边缘的轮廓更清了，法相手臂的线条从模糊的云状变成了明确的、像被刀刻过一样的硬线。第三年结束的时候，十丈法相已经能完整地维持住自己的形态。
第四年。
他在第四年的第一周站了起来。法相也跟着他站了起来，十丈的高度刚好顶到修炼室的顶壁。顶壁是灵铁板，厚约一尺。
法相的头颅贴上去的时候，灵铁板发出了持续的嗡鸣——那种声音很低，像一面被震动的鼓皮被什么东西压住了，正在持续地、闷闷地发声。他把法相收回去，又放出来。反复了大概几十次。
每一次收放都比上一次更流畅，像一条正在被反复折叠又展开的布，折痕正在慢慢变浅。法相的轮廓在第四年的中段开始有了细微的变化。它的肩比原来宽了半寸，脊背的线条更直了。那种变化不是他主动调整的，是灵能在长期压缩中自然重塑的结果。
第五年。
第五年的第一个月，他坐在蒲团上，把法相完整地展开了一次。十丈。轮廓清晰，光芒收敛但浑厚，像一块已经被锻打了很多遍的铁正在慢慢冷却到可以拿起来使用的温度。他看了一会儿，然后把法相收回去。
第二个月，他开始做最后一步——不是收，是放。那一瞬间，十丈法相从他背后完全展开，金光从修炼室的每一处缝隙中渗出去。门缝、墙缝、地面与灵铁板之间的接缝、通风口的栅栏间隙——金色的光芒从所有这些地方漫出来，像水被压进了裂缝之后从每一个出口同时涌出。
上国基地的上空在那一瞬间变成了一片流动的金色。光持续了大约十息，然后开始收拢。金色的光芒从天空的边缘向中央汇聚，像一面正在被折叠的旗帜，最后叠成一枚细小的光点，消失在了基地上空最高的那根灵能塔的顶端。
基地里正在耕作的人抬头看了一眼天空，然后低头继续翻地。食堂的厨师看了一眼窗外，然后把锅盖重新盖上了。训练场上的教官看了一眼天顶，然后转回去继续指导方阵。没有人说话。没有人讨论。因为他们都知道，那道金光是从哪扇门里渗出来的。那扇门还没有开。但光已经出来了。
修炼室内部，张德华坐在蒲团上，睁着眼。十丈法相在他身后站着，高度正好是十丈，轮廓清晰到能看见指尖的纹路。他低头看了看自己的手掌，掌心那枚透明的结晶碎块已经完全消失了。皮肤光滑，连一丝痕迹都没留下。他站起来。膝盖没有弯，没有酸胀。他走到门前，手按上开关，停了一息，然后按了下去。
门开了。门缝里透进来的光线比他想象中亮。走廊里的灯还是那排冷白色，但此刻看起来比关闭之前更亮了一些。他跨过门槛走了出去走向广场。
广场上的人比预计中多。
消息是三天前传出去的，食堂门口贴了一张布告，演武场的告示板上也贴了一张。布告上只写了一句话——"大帝出关，法相展示，所有在基地的人均可观礼。"后勤处的人搬出了仓库里所有的长凳，摆成七排，从高台前方一直延伸到广场外围的灵草田边缘。又临时加了三排折叠椅。
全基地三千多人已经全部到了，还有很多人是提前两天从外围哨站赶回来的，没有换衣服，风尘仆仆地站在人群外围。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The National System of Immortal Cultivation Submitted to the National Text Chapter 066: The practice of Shizhang Dharma Appearance Begins (..la) Time accelerates and the door of the practice room closes slower than he imagined.
Zhang Dehua stood on the inside of the threshold and watched the door panels move from both sides to the middle. As the door gap narrows, the light outside is being compressed inch by inch, from three fingers to two fingers, from two fingers to one finger, and finally only a hair-like thin line is left. The thin line stayed on the floor for about a breath and then went out.
The light inside the practice room is cold white, shining evenly from the spiritual light plates at the four corners of the ceiling. He stood in the light and glanced down at his right hand.
The traces of the crystal fragments on the palm are still there - transparent, like washed glass fragments, embedded between the palm lines. It doesn't hurt, but you can feel that there is a small area that is harder than the surrounding skin. He turned his palm over and looked at the light. The transparent fragments reflected a faint golden color under the cold white light, like a gold fragment buried in the sand. He put his hands down without looking much, walked to the futon and sat down.
There is a shallow mark on the edge of the futon. When he left last time, a very shallow dent was made where he was sitting under his weight. Fifteen days later, the dent was still there and had not rebounded. He put his hands on his knees, brought them together, and closed his eyes.
First year.
He didn't move for the first four months. The process of refining the crystal fragment took longer than expected. The transparent fragment was being peeled off layer by layer by his spiritual energy, like peeling an onion. Each layer had a trace of very faint golden light seeping from the meridians in his palm into his Dantian. In the fifth month, the shadow of his Dharma began to gather behind his back.
Eighty feet. The same height as the time at the entrance to the forbidden area. But this time the light was more stable than that time, without flickering or trembling, like a bronze statue that had been cast and was slowly cooling. He tried to close it. As he gathered it, he felt a resistance - like a man trying to stuff a water-soaked quilt into a much smaller box.
The edge of the Dharma image stopped when it reached sixty feet and did not shrink any further. He tried three times, but each time he stopped at sixty feet, as if he had hit an invisible wall.
On the seventh month, he started to change his approach. Don't force it to close, first observe the "wall".
He discovered that the wall was not the boundary of the Dharma itself, but a certain layer of structure in the crystal fragments that was resisting the compression force of his spiritual energy. The structure is very thin, like a bookmark sandwiched between two layers of paper. It took him a full month to separate it from the crystalline fragments. After peeling it off, the Dharma form shrank from sixty feet to fifty feet. There was a gap of three and a half months between the fifty and forty feet.
Four months and seven days passed between forty feet and thirty feet. Between thirty feet and twenty feet, it was the last month of the year - it took him thirty days to press the Dharma from thirty feet to twenty feet. Twenty feet.
Second year.
Twenty feet is another wall. It was thicker and harder than the last time. He tried to peel it off using the same method, but this layer of structure had been integrated with the Dharma itself and was inseparable. He can only "grind" it with continuous psychic pressure.
For two hours every day, pour spiritual energy into the Dharma, like a craftsman carving stone with a hand chisel. Progress is slow. In the first month, twenty feet to nineteen feet. In the second month, it reaches eighteen feet.
The third month to the seventeenth foot. The progress accelerated a bit in the tenth month - he found an angle and poured spiritual energy into the left shoulder of the Dharma, and the resistance suddenly became smaller.
In the last two months, he went from twelve feet to eleven feet. But between the eleventh and tenth feet, he tried many times, and every time he was bounced back to eleven feet.
Third year.
The first of the third yearmonth, he paused compression.
He sat on the futon, withdrew his psychic energy and rested completely for three days.
For three days, he did nothing but sit, breathe, and feel the constant cold white light in the training room shining down from above his head. On the evening of the third day, when he started again, he found that the resistance had loosened a little. It didn't disappear completely, but it loosened a little, like a door that had been stuck for a long time and loosened half an inch on its own due to the drying and shrinkage of the wood. When he sent the spiritual energy in, the Dharma's image shrank from eleven feet to ten and a half feet.
That section was only half a foot long, but he felt that the texture of the wall was changing, from "rejection" to "accommodation". In the last six months of the third year, he focused on stabilizing the form of the Shizhang Dharma.
Every time the Dharma image stopped at ten feet, he could feel its density increasing.
The light is denser, the outline of the edge is clearer, and the lines of the Buddha's arm have changed from vague cloud-like shapes to clear, hard lines as if they had been carved by a knife. At the end of the third year, the Shizhang Faxiang was able to maintain its form completely.
Fourth year.
He stood up in the first week of his fourth year. Dharma Prime also stood up after him, with a height of ten feet just touching the top wall of the practice room. The top wall is made of spiritual iron plate, about one foot thick.
When the monk's head was pressed against it, the spiritual iron plate made a continuous buzzing sound - the sound was very low, like a vibrated drum skin being suppressed by something, making a continuous, muffled sound. He took the Dharma image back and released it again. This was repeated probably dozens of times.
Each folding and unfolding is smoother than the last, like a piece of cloth being folded and unfolded repeatedly, and the creases are slowly becoming shallower. The outline of the image begins to change slightly in the middle of the fourth year. Its shoulders were half an inch wider than before, and the line of its back was straighter. That change was not something he actively adjusted, but was the result of the natural reshaping of psychic energy during long-term compression.
Fifth year.
In the first month of the fifth year, he sat on the futon and unfolded the Dharma image completely. Ten feet. The outline is clear, and the light is restrained but thick, like a piece of iron that has been forged many times and is slowly cooling to a temperature that can be picked up and used. He looked at it for a while and then took it back.
In the second month, he began to take the final step - not to collect, but to release. At that moment, the ten-foot-long dharma image was fully unfolded from behind him, and golden light seeped out from every gap in the practice room. The cracks in the door, the wall, the seams between the ground and the spiritual iron plate, the gaps between the bars of the vents - golden light spread out from all these places, like water being pressed into the cracks and then pouring out from every exit at the same time.
The sky above the Shangguo base turned into a flowing golden color at that moment. The light lasted for about ten breaths and then began to shrink. The golden light converged from the edge of the sky to the center, like a folded flag, and finally folded into a tiny point of light, disappearing at the top of the tallest psychic tower above the base.
The people who were farming at the base looked up at the sky, then lowered their heads and continued to plow the ground. The chef in the cafeteria glanced out the window and then put the lid back on the pot. The instructor on the training ground glanced at the zenith, then turned back to continue instructing the phalanx. No one spoke. No one discussed it. Because they all knew which door the golden light came from. That door isn't open yet. But the light has come out.
Inside the training room, Zhang Dehua sat on the futon with his eyes open. The Dharma Appearance of Shizhang stood behind him, his height was exactly ten feet, and his outline was so clear that you could see the lines on his fingertips. He looked down at his palm, and the transparent crystal fragment in his palm had completely disappeared. The skin is smooth, leaving not even a trace. He stood up. The knees are not bent and there is no soreness. He walked to the door, pressed the switch, paused for a moment, and then pressed it.
The door opened. The light coming through the crack in the door was brighter than he imagined.The lights in the corridor were still the same cold white, but now they seemed brighter than before they were turned off. He crossed the threshold and walked out toward the square.
There were more people in the square than expected.
The news spread three days ago. A notice was posted at the door of the cafeteria and one was also posted on the bulletin board of the martial arts arena. There was only one sentence written on the notice - "The Emperor has left seclusion, the Dharma is on display, and everyone at the base can watch." The people from the logistics office moved out all the benches in the warehouse and arranged them in seven rows, extending from the front of the high platform to the edge of the spiritual grass field outside the square. Three rows of folding chairs were temporarily added.
All the more than 3,000 people in the base have arrived, and many of them have rushed back from the outpost two days in advance. They have not changed their clothes and are standing outside the crowd covered in dust.
